narratives.Description: security(install): pin+verify Git-for-Windows download before silent exec (install-deposit-01). This story remediates a confirmed AppSec finding from tracker #2904 with fail-closed tests and CHANGELOG citation. Parent umbrella remains open until all batch children merge.
narratives.Overview:
## Parent
Part of AppSec scan tracker **#2904** (2026-07-29). Remediation **Batch A** (installer authenticity).

## Finding
| | |
| --- | --- |
| **ID** | `install-deposit-01` |
| **Severity** | **High** |
| **Dimension** | `install-deposit` |
| **File** | [`cmd/deft-install/git.go`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/master/cmd/deft-install/git.go) |

## Issue
On Windows, when winget fails, `deft-install` downloads the latest git-for-windows 64-bit `.exe` via GitHub API and runs it `/SILENT` `/NORESTART` with **no SHA-256 or Authenticode pin**. Trust is TLS+GitHub-latest only.

## Impact
Compromised git-for-windows release, asset, or MitM yields arbitrary code execution as the installing user during automated install.

## Remediation
1. Pin a known-good Git.Git version; verify SHA-256 (and ideally Authenticode) before exec.
2. Prefer winget with a pinned package version.
3. Refuse silent install when verification fails.
4. Document trust boundary if pinning is deferred.

## Acceptance
- [ ] No Git-for-Windows download-and-exec path runs without pinned digest (or documented residual + non-silent opt-in)
- [ ] Tests or installer dry-run fixtures cover fail-closed mismatch
- [ ] CHANGELOG / docs/security.md updated as needed

## Refs
- Tracker #2904
- Batch A sibling: install-deposit-02
- Prior partial harden: #1303 (non-2xx/timeout only)
narratives.UserStory: As a security engineer, I want pin and SHA-256 verify Git-for-Windows installer assets before silent exec, so that Windows deft-install cannot run a compromised latest release.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Open the source module files under cmd/deft-install/git.go (and related paths: cmd/deft-install/git.go, cmd/deft-install/, docs/security.md, CHANGELOG.md) and implement the fail-closed fix described in issue #2908. 2. Add or extend unit tests/fixtures that assert the security property; run verify commands: cd cmd/deft-install && go test ./...; task check:merge. 3. Update CHANGELOG.md and docs/security.md when the finding changes documented trust boundaries; collect evidence from test output before opening the PR.
